snippet.title: Spinful Demo Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4228600/Spinful/

Join the Spinful Discord here!: https://discord.gg/rMDgVRtbJ9

A fantasy roguelite slot-builder. Upgrade, enhance and customize your slots into a powerful combat machine! Explore vibrant themed pixel art worlds, hunt for game-breaking trinkets, and chase the ultimate high-roll.

Coming to Steam later this year.
